scope.real: Coordinator.handoff_step, guarded_cas.dispatch, build snapshots, isolated cas_work.py, artifact checks, two filesystem CAS stores, reopened SQLite journal and write triggers
scope.simulated: submit_isolated supplies the SSH/admission response. All workers execute locally. Recovery resubmits the original step with its job ID. No queue delivery is exercised.
scope.bytes: Block counters are uncompressed input bytes. Snapshot bytes are ZIP bodies delivered to the local worker. No network bytes are measured.
